title: TABLE 64 SPEAK WITH DEAD - the six level bands with the maximum dead time, the questioning time and the question counts
audit_label: R667 OA speak with dead audit
audit_comment: OA round fifty-four (capture p. 132): Table 64 - the speak with dead ladder by shukenja level, the maximum dead time, questioning time and question counts per band, cross-checked between the passes

banner.title: TABLE 64 SPEAK WITH DEAD, printed capture p. 132 - the OA speak with dead round
banner.provenance: pinned from the 2018 print capture (the settling authority), with the compressed-print capture giving a second independent read (print p. 132; compressed pp. 64-65); the six band rows cross-checked line by line between the passes, zero contested reads - the one OCR variance is the compressed 2 turn on the 13-15 questioning row against the print's 2 turns (the print settles). The table answers the third level speak with dead spell: the number of questions is dependent on level. The bands pin as a chain (the shukenja's level mapped to its band: 6 and below the least band, 7-8, 9-12, 13-15, 16-20, more than 20 the tail) and a three-column grid: the maximum dead time in days (the 7-day week, the 30-day month and the 365-day year conventions, then a decade climb per band up to the 1000-year greatest band pinned 365000), the questioning time in segments (one round, three rounds, one turn, two turns, three turns, six turns - the round = 10 and turn = 60 conventions) and the question counts climbing one per band from two to seven - the band ordinal plus the dibT64QuestionsBase pin. The band names ride the column comments, the spell prose closes in its own round. The table tag T64Data identifier-safe per the R639 lesson
banner.sentinel: the gap census after this round: 120 closed, 115 open - the Table 64 Speak with Dead box flips (census 589 -> 590); NEXT - R668: the Table 65 Fate (print p. 135), prefix dic (verify free), audit "R668 OA fate audit"
